AI Grant contract between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and County and Actors Bridge Enxemble Theater of Nashville, Inc. Contract # March 22, 2007 GRANT CONTRACT BETWEEN THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY AND ACTORS BRIDGE ENSEMBLE THEATER OF NASHVILLE, INC. This Grant Contract issued and entered into pursuant to RS2007-1826, by and between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, a municipal corporation of the State of Tennessee hereinafter referred to as “Metro” and Actors Bridge Ensemble Theater of Nashville, Inc., 1312 Adams Street, hereinafter referred to as the “Recipient,” is for the provision of a portion of professional artists’ fees, as further defined in the "SCOPE OF PROGRAM." For purposes of this contract, the Metro Council Office acknowledges proper receipt of all documents as required by MCL
5.04.070. A. SCOPE OF PROGRAM: grantee shall use the funds to pay a portion of the professional artists’ fees for the production of “ORDINARY HEROES”, an original play about role in the struggle for civil rights. A.2. These funds shall be expended consistent with the plan described above. A.3. The recipient shall utilize this Metro funding for services which the recipient provides to documented residents of Davidson County only. Documentation shall be that such as a recent utility bill, voter's registration card, driver's license or other government issued-ID, current record from a public school (excluding colleges and other post-high school institutes) within Davidson County showing address, affidavit by landlord, or affidavit by nonprofit treatment, shelter, half- way house, or homeless assistance entity. Utilization of this Metro funding for services to non- Davidson County residents is unallowable. A.4. Additionally, the recipient shall collect data on the primary county of residence of the clients it serves and provide that data to Metro along with its final program and expenditure reports. B. GRANT CONTRACT TERM: B.1. Grant Contract Term. The term of this Grant shall be for a period of twelve (12) months, commencing on July 1, 2006 and ending on June 30, 2007. Metro shall have no obligation for services rendered by the Recipient, which are not performed within this term. Cc. PAYMENT TERMS AND CONDITIONS: C.1. Maximum Liability. In no event shall the maximum liability of Metro under this Grant Contract exceed Three Thousand Dollars ($3,000). This amount shall constitute the Grant Amount and the entire compensation due the Recipient. C.2. Firm. The maximum liability of Metro is not subject to escalation for any reason. C.3. Payment Methodology. The Recipient shall be compensated for actual costs based upon the plan described in Section A.1., not to exceed the maximum liability established in Section C.1. The Recipient shall submit invoices and any supporting documentation as requested by Metro to demonstrate that the funds are being used as required by this Grant, prior to any payment for allowable costs. No invoice exceeding the amount of $100,000 shall be accepted. ARCHIVE
